prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1172; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Rear bumper cover cracked across the center with the left tail lamp assembly broken, and the trunk lid edge has a crease consistent with the reported rear impact. The damage pattern matches the described collision, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is known from the file. The proposed plan replaces the bumper cover and tail lamp, repairs the trunk lid edge, and refinishes the affected panels. The labor hours submitted fit the damage shown, and the invoices present no repeated charges. Recommend approval of the repair as written.
